candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether reported breadth deterioration or recovery preceded price moves and whether participation broadened beyond changing top-100 snapshots; this would help distinguish persistent participation changes from endpoint or membership effects.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews repeatedly note proxy-only breadth, changing membership hashes, and missing breadth paths; W37 reviews also lack the construction and timestamp of the cited breadth observation.
candidates.metric_name: Point-in-time breadth constituents and daily advancer/decliner counts
candidates.missing_history_problem: No comparable historical breadth series with recorded universe membership, constituent returns, and capture times is supplied. Snapshot comparisons cannot establish persistence or a like-for-like change.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish the ordering and persistence of positioning and spot-liquidity changes relative to drawdowns and rebounds, addressing repeated uncertainty about late recognition, transient leverage resets, and whether cited conditions followed rather than preceded weakness.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily analyses describe liquidation aggregates as lower bounds, OI and flow evidence as mixed, and microstructure as brief snapshots; weekly reviews say the time order and magnitudes of OI, depth, and price observations are unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped BTC/ETH open interest, spot depth imbalance, taker imbalance, and liquidation observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied observations are sparse, differently timed, or explicitly incomplete; there is no aligned historical sequence adequate to assess lead-lag or persistence.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit ex-ante audit of candidate precision, sequence integrity, and subsequent path outcomes without using later information as if it were available at issuance; this directly addresses repeated inability to score candidates or evaluate warning opportunity cost.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report missing candidate definitions, issue times, freeze-time observations, and candidate-linked matured outcomes despite aggregate matured-outcome counts; daily reviews identify broad unratified ranges and descriptive, overlapping protection cohorts.
candidates.metric_name: Candidate-vintage record joined to point-in-time evidence and matured metric-path outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate-level specifications and outcomes are not provided together with the exact evidence available at issuance, so hit/miss, range containment, and post-warning path comparisons cannot be reconstructed without hindsight risk.
